verdict.rationale: Aider installs and runs on the user's own machine via pip or an install script and operates on the local git repo. It can also run against local models such as Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible local API, so the whole stack can be self-hosted. missing for 10: evidence that the source is openly licensed or buildable from source, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted or offline setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Aider can work also with local models, for example using Ollama. It can also access local models that provide an Open AI compatible API.
